clause_a: Clause 4.1: The bidder must submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of $50,000 via irrevocable bank guarantee.
clause_b: Clause 18.3: Bid security deposit is specified as $75,000 payable by demand draft before bid submission.
description: Direct numerical conflict in bid security / EMD deposit amount ($50,000 vs $75,000).

clause_a: Section 8.2: The contractor warrants all delivered hardware against defects for a period of 12 months from commercial acceptance.
clause_b: Schedule C: All supplied computer hardware and peripherals shall carry a comprehensive 36-month on-site warranty.
description: Direct numerical discrepancy in warranty duration (12 months vs 36 months).

clause_a: Clause 11.5: Liquidated damages for delayed milestones shall be capped at 5% of the total contract value.
clause_b: Clause 22.1: The maximum cumulative deduction for liquidated damages is 10% of the overall order value.
description: Conflict in liquidated damages liability cap (5% vs 10%).

clause_a: Section 1.3: All technical and financial bids must be received no later than November 15, 2026, 17:00 UTC.
clause_b: Clause 2.1: The deadline for submission of bids is November 30, 2026, 17:00 UTC.
description: Conflicting tender closing dates across different sections (Nov 15 vs Nov 30).

clause_a: Clause 3.2: The pre-bid clarification conference will be conducted on December 05, 2026.
clause_b: Clause 1.4: Bids must be submitted no later than November 30, 2026.
description: Chronological impossibility: pre-bid meeting occurs after the tender submission closes.

clause_a: Clause 2.4: Technical bids will be opened publicly on November 10, 2026, at 14:00 hours.
clause_b: Clause 2.2: The closing date for submission of tenders is November 20, 2026.
description: Chronological impossibility: public opening occurs prior to the submission deadline.

clause_a: Clause 5.1: The contractor must deliver all 500 laptops within 30 days of contract execution.
clause_b: Clause 9.3: Equipment delivery shall be completed within one month of formal contract signing.
description: Complementary and logically entailed delivery requirement (30 days = one month).

clause_a: Clause 6.2: The supplier shall maintain ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications throughout the contract lifecycle.
clause_b: Clause 14.1: Bidders must possess valid ISO quality management and information security certifications.
description: Consistent qualification standards reinforcing the same compliance criteria.

clause_a: Clause 7.1: Server racks must be 42U high with front and rear perforated steel mesh doors.
clause_b: Clause 19.4: The contractor must maintain comprehensive third-party general liability insurance of $2,000,000.
description: Completely unrelated specifications (hardware rack physical form factor vs insurance policy).

clause_a: Clause 3.1: Minimum annual turnover of the bidder shall be $5,000,000 in each of the past three fiscal years.
clause_b: Clause 12.2: All delivered software code must pass automated static application security testing (SAST).
description: Unrelated provisions (financial turnover threshold vs code security testing standard).

clause_a: Clause 1.1: This tender is issued under the public procurement regulations of the Republic of Ireland.
clause_b: Clause 25.1: This tender is issued under the public procurement regulations of the Republic of Ireland.

clause_a: Clause 4.2: Liquidated damages shall be levied at 0.5% per week of delay.
clause_b: Clause 15.3: Liquidated damages shall be levied at 1.5% per week of delay.
description: Repeated clause with contradictory penalty rates (0.5% vs 1.5% per week).

clause_a: Clause 8.1: Subcontracting is permitted only upon prior written consent from the Authority.
clause_b: Clause 16.4: The contractor may freely assign or subcontract implementation tasks to accredited partners.
description: Contradictory and ambiguous subcontracting rights (prohibited without consent vs freely allowed).

clause_a: Clause 10.2: Liquidated damages are applicable immediately upon milestone delay without cure period.
clause_b: Clause 17.1: In the event of delay, the contractor shall be afforded a mandatory 14-day cure period before penalties accrue.
description: Ambiguous penalty conditions (immediate accrual vs mandatory 14-day cure period).
